description: What a game or the editor has printed, each entry with a severity. Op run also answers counts, and clean, true when no error was reported. clean is absent when the console was lost, or when a game the editor played left no runtime report (errorsUnread true). A run that has quit still answers until the next one starts. Operations: run: what the game started by editor_run has printed; editor: what the editor itself has printed, from its first line. Default run.

before.description: How many ordinary lines above a repeated group to carry with it. Default 3. For op editor.

contains.description: Only entries mentioning this text, matched against everything the run has printed.

cpu.description: Also answer with cpuSeconds, the processor time the run has used. Costs a subprocess. For op run.

limit.description: The most entries to answer with, newest kept. Identical entries come back as one with times. Default 200.

projectPath.description: The project whose output you mean. Refused unless a run or the editor here is of it.

severity.description: The least severe entry to include. Default info, which is everything.

sinceLastCall.description: Only entries not already answered at this severity. Default false. For op run.

name: editor_output
title: Game and editor output
